# LocalCloud

> LocalCloud is a local Google Cloud emulator: one Docker container that serves 25 Google Cloud services on localhost, so developers, CI jobs, and AI coding agents can run Google Cloud code without a GCP account, credentials, or billing.

- Runs BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, Spanner, Bigtable, Firestore, Cloud SQL, Memorystore (Redis/Valkey), Dataproc, Cloud Run, and more in one container.
- Standard Google Cloud SDKs and Terraform connect through generated emulator environment variables.
- Stores local state in a named Docker volume and includes a web console for service health and local data.
- Installs as a CLI on macOS and Linux; any Docker host can run the container directly.
- Free during the public preview for non-production use, and free for open-source projects.

Use LocalCloud for development, testing, and CI, and validate application behavior against real Google Cloud before production deployment.

## Quick start

```bash
curl -fsSL https://local.cloud/install.sh | sh
localcloud doctor
localcloud start --local-only
curl -fsS http://localhost:5380/readiness
eval "$(localcloud env)"
localcloud console
```

- Homebrew alternative to the first line: `brew install LocalGCloud/tap/localcloud`.
- `localcloud start` waits for the runtime. The CLI remaps a default port when it is in use; use the URLs and endpoint values it returns.
- Without the CLI (for example on Windows), follow the [manual Docker path](https://local.cloud/docs/#manual-docker-path).

## Runtime facts

- Default project: `local-gcp-project`
- Default user: `local-developer`
- Default data volume: `localcloud-data`; select another with `--data-volume NAME`.
- CLI memory default: `4g`
- Readiness endpoint (wait for it before application traffic): `http://localhost:5380/readiness`
- Health endpoint: `http://localhost:5380/health`
- Shell environment: `http://localhost:5380/env?format=shell`
- Terraform environment: `http://localhost:5380/env?format=terraform`

## Services

Every service in the table runs locally. Firestore, GKE, and Cloud Run are opt-in: `--services` sets the exact list of service IDs to run, for example `localcloud start --local-only --services firestore,gcs,pubsub`. Google Sheets serves read-only spreadsheet values as fixtures for other services.

| Service | ID | Starts by default | Endpoints | Environment variable | Guide |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Cloud Storage | `gcs` | yes | HTTP/REST :5382 | `STORAGE_EMULATOR_HOST=http://localhost:5382` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/cloud-storage/) |
| Pub/Sub | `pubsub` | yes | gRPC :5383 | `PUBSUB_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5383` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/pubsub/) |
| Firestore | `firestore` | opt-in | gRPC :5384 | `FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5384` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/firestore/) |
| Bigtable | `bigtable` | yes | gRPC :5385 | `BIGTABLE_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5385` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/bigtable/) |
| Spanner | `spanner` | yes | gRPC :5386 · HTTP/REST :5387 | `SPANNER_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5386` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/spanner/) |
| BigQuery | `bigquery` | yes | HTTP/REST :5388 · gRPC :5389 | `BIGQUERY_EMULATOR_HOST=http://localhost:5388` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/bigquery/) |
| Google Sheets | `sheets` | yes | HTTP/REST :5380 | `SHEETS_EMULATOR_HOST=http://localhost:5380` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/google-sheets/) |
| Secret Manager | `secretmanager` | yes | gRPC :5380 | `SECRET_MANAGER_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/secret-manager/) |
| Cloud Tasks | `cloudtasks` | yes | gRPC :5380 | `CLOUD_TASKS_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/cloud-tasks/) |
| Cloud Scheduler | `cloudscheduler` | yes | grpc+rest :5380 | `CLOUD_SCHEDULER_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/cloud-scheduler/) |
| Cloud Functions (2nd Gen) | `cloudfunctions` | yes | gRPC :5380 | `CLOUD_FUNCTIONS_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/cloud-functions/) |
| AlloyDB | `alloydb` | yes | gRPC :5380 | `ALLOYDB_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/alloydb/) |
| Dataproc | `dataproc` | yes | gRPC :5380 | `DATAPROC_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/dataproc/) |
| Cloud IAM | `cloudiam` | yes | gRPC :5380 | `IAM_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/cloud-iam/) |
| Cloud Resource Manager | `cloudresourcemanager` | yes | HTTP/REST :5380 | `CLOUD_RESOURCE_MANAGER_EMULATOR_HOST=http://localhost:5380` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/cloud-resource-manager/) |
| Service Usage | `serviceusage` | yes | HTTP/REST :5380 | `SERVICE_USAGE_EMULATOR_HOST=http://localhost:5380` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/service-usage/) |
| Cloud Billing | `cloudbilling` | yes | HTTP/REST :5380 | `CLOUD_BILLING_EMULATOR_HOST=http://localhost:5380` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/cloud-billing/) |
| Cloud Logging | `logging` | yes | gRPC :5380 | `CLOUD_LOGGING_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/cloud-logging/) |
| Cloud Monitoring | `monitoring` | yes | gRPC :5380 | `CLOUD_MONITORING_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/cloud-monitoring/) |
| GKE | `gke` | opt-in | gRPC :5380 · k3d :5443 | `GKE_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/gke/) |
| Cloud Run | `cloudrun` | opt-in | gRPC :5380 | `CLOUD_RUN_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/cloud-run/) |
| Memorystore (Redis/Valkey) | `memorystore` | yes | RESP :5390 | `REDIS_HOST=localhost:5390` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/memorystore/) |
| Cloud Workflows | `workflows` | yes | gRPC :5380 | `WORKFLOWS_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/cloud-workflows/) |
| Cloud KMS | `kms` | yes | grpc+rest :5380 | `CLOUD_KMS_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/cloud-kms/) |
| Cloud SQL | `cloudsql` | yes | HTTP/REST :5380 · PostgreSQL :5391 · MySQL :5406 | `CLOUD_SQL_EMULATOR_HOST=http://localhost:5380` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/cloud-sql/) |

Unsupported locally; use Google Cloud:

- [Compute Engine](https://local.cloud/services/compute-engine/) — unsupported
- [Vertex AI](https://local.cloud/services/vertex-ai/) — unsupported

## License

The proprietary Public Preview License permits individuals and organizations, including for-profit companies, to use LocalCloud free of charge for internal development, testing, CI, evaluation, and internal pilots. Excluded uses: customer-facing or other production use; reselling LocalCloud or providing it as a hosted or managed service; redistribution or sublicensing; and modification except where applicable law requires permission. Open-source projects can use LocalCloud free of charge for development, testing, and ongoing internal CI under the Free for open-source projects policy, which continues after the public preview ends.
